miami-2024.detail: The safety car picked up Verstappen while Norris led, so Norris ran on ahead of it

hungary-2024.detail: McLaren told Norris to give the lead back to Piastri; he slowed on the start-finish straight on lap 68
hungary-2024.note: Lap 68 in the article and in the timing (PIA ahead at the end of lap 68)

hungary-2024.detail: Touched Hamilton diving down the inside at turn 1, went off track and lost fourth to Leclerc
hungary-2024.note: Lap 63 and turn 1 in GrandPrix.com's race notes and Autosport (https://www.autosport.com/f1/news/fia-hamilton-could-have-done-more-to-avoid-verstappen-clash-but-no-action-taken/10637398/). No source names damage: it costs its contact lap only (laps 1), fitted from the timing

japan-2023.note: Race control: VSC deployed and ending on lap 14 (lap 14 in the built model too), for debris after Pérez hit Magnussen at turn 11 (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2023_Japanese_Grand_Prix). The lap-1 SC (Bottas/Albon debris, in on lap 4) is before the takeover

japan-2023.detail: McLaren swapped its cars on the hards after discussing Russell's one-stop threat: Piastri let Norris back into second
japan-2023.note: Autosport's '10 things' gives no lap; GrandPrix.com's race notes put Norris back in second in the lap-26 entries and record no order. The timing (FastF1) has PIA ahead of NOR at the end of lap 26 and NOR ahead from the end of lap 27, kept as the sims' lap

japan-2023.detail: Mercedes told Russell to swap places; Hamilton went by at the first corner to take fifth
japan-2023.note: Lap 49 in GrandPrix.com's race notes (Autosport: with five laps left); the timing (FastF1) has HAM ahead of RUS from the end of lap 49

great-britain-2023.note: Race control: VSC then SC deployed on lap 33, SC in on lap 38 (the built model has one SC from lap 33, 6 laps); Magnussen's engine failed on the Wellington straight (https://www.autosport.com/f1/news/f1-british-gp-race-report/10493893/); Jolpica status Retired (31 laps)

singapore-2014.note: Debris after Sutil and Pérez touched at Turn 8 (Pérez's front wing broke). Wikipedia puts the SC out on lap 30, GrandPrix.com on lap 31 (https://www.grandprix.com/races/singapore-gp-2014-race-notes-hamilton-wins-signapore-gp.html); the built model has it from lap 31, 7 laps, in at the end of lap 37 as in Wikipedia and Motor Sport

canada-2016.note: The VSC was for Button's McLaren engine failure (Motor Sport says lap 10; Jolpica: 9 laps, status Power Unit). The built model has a one-lap VSC on lap 11; its end lap is not in the sources

saudi-arabia-2023.note: Race control: SC deployed on lap 18, in this lap on lap 20 (the built model has one SC from lap 18, 3 laps); Stroll stopped on track (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2023_Saudi_Arabian_Grand_Prix, lap 17; GrandPrix.com lap 18); Jolpica status Retired (16 laps)

great-britain-2021.detail: Mercedes told Bottas to let Hamilton by; he did, at Stowe, on lap 40

russia-2018.detail: Mercedes asked Bottas to let Hamilton through into second at turn 13
russia-2018.note: The article gives lap 26; the timing (FastF1) has HAM ahead of BOT from the end of lap 25, kept as the sims' lap

australia-2018.note: Grosjean stopped at turn 2 with a wheel not fitted properly after his stop, which brought out the VSC (Wikipedia; Autosport has him stopping on lap 24). Autosport (how-hamiltons-needless-loss-revealed-a-mercedes-flaw-5110682) has the VSC deployed on lap 26, as in the built model (TUM track status); Jolpica status Wheel (24 laps)
The VSC for Grosjean's car became a full safety car on lap 27 (Wikipedia) and came in at the end of lap 31; the built model (TUM track status) starts the SC on lap 28, kept as the sims' lap

spain-2017.note: Vandoorne hit Massa at turn 1 and ended in the gravel (Wikipedia, Motor Sport); VSC on lap 34 (Motor Sport, and the built model's TUM track status) or lap 33 (Autosport); Jolpica status Collision (32 laps)

belgium-1998.detail: Jordan's order in the closing stages: Ralf Schumacher not to overtake Hill ('Ralf, you cannot overtake Damon, that is a team order', race engineer Sam Michael, Autosport)
belgium-1998.note: A hold order, not a let-by: the article gives no lap, only the closing stages after the restart 'with 12 laps to go' (lap 33 of 44, Autosport). Entered as one let-by item on each green lap from 33 to 44 (an item lapses once HIL is ahead), so a sim SCH that gets ahead of HIL is put back behind him and stays there. The timing (Jolpica) has HIL ahead of SCH at the end of every lap from 26 to the flag

great-britain-2016.detail: Gearbox problem in the closing laps; the team told him to avoid seventh gear, after which he held his lead over Verstappen
great-britain-2016.note: The article gives no lap: 'As Räikkönen got back into fifth at the expense of Pérez, Rosberg reported problems with his gearbox'. Räikkönen passed Pérez on lap 46 in the timing (FastF1); Rosberg's laps 46-47 are 3.2 s and 2.5 s over his laps either side, and VER closes from 6.2 s to 2.0 s. Two laps (46-47) from the timing: the article says he 'was able to consolidate his slim lead' once he avoided seventh
